<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/metastationapi/socialTrade/webhook/{accountId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Send a trading signal to execute on the account slot associated with the
webhook secret in the URL. Accepts JSON or natural language in the body.

Copy the exact URL from Webhook Management -&gt; Webhook URLs rather than
assembling it by hand.

A 200 means the signal was accepted and QUEUED, not that the order
filled. Confirm real state from your positions or the signal log.
